Resorts World NYC's partnership with Cirrus began investing in workforce/affordable housing developments in the immediate term
Status: UNVERIFIED
The cited sources document the terms of the undertaking.
Promised scope: Promisor/actor: Resorts World New York City, through a new partnership/joint venture with Cirrus (with labor pension funds and contractors referenced in the public announcement). Intended beneficiaries: working- and middle-class families / working families. Location: public announcement says projects across the five boroughs; agreement materials define investments in workforce housing in New York City and its suburbs. Benefit/action: begin investing in new workforce/affordable housing developments. Material condition: the investment start was promised to occur 'in the immediate term.'
Observed scope: Delivery for the promised scope remains unverified.
Evidence gap: The sources do not establish actual performance for the promised scope. Timing to verify: The partnership was promised to 'begin investing in new housing developments in the immediate term.'
Promise evidence: c1, c2, c3

Cited source excerpts (promise, delivery, or context as assessed above):
c1: “The new partnership will begin investing in new housing developments in the immediate term. This landmark agreement with Cirrus, labor pension funds, and contractors will ensure there is affordable housing financed by, built by, and lived in by working- and middle-class families.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/resorts-world-new-york-city-local-impact-siting-mitigating-potential-impacts-communities-local-0

c2: “Resorts World New York City has officially formed a joint venture with Cirrus to invest in this housing commitment, which will focus on large-scale projects across the five boroughs. The new partnership will begin to invest in new housing developments in the immediate term.”
https://rwnewyork.com/rws-next-chapter/resorts-world-new-york-city-cirrus-unveil-new-agreement-to-build-up-to-50000-units-of-workforce-housing/

c3: ““Investments” means (i) co-investments by the Partnership with other investment vehicles and partnerships managed by the Management Company in the development and ownership of workforce housing in New York City and its suburbs (“Co-Investments”); (ii) investments by the Partnership alongside other Management Company anchor investors within the Management Company’s flagship funds in order to support further investments by these vehicles in the development and ownership of workforce housing in New York City and its suburbs”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2026/02/exhibit-175-rwnyc-cirrus-partnership-agreement_redacted.pdf

c4: “Resorts World's Workforce Housing Initiative, funded through the Cirrus Workforce Housing Fund, is a landmark partnership with organized labor to deliver tens of thousands of new homes for working families across New York City.”
https://rwnewyork.com/community/community-investments/workforce-housing/

c5: “WHEREAS, the Parties desire to amplify both the actual and perceived scale and results of the RWNYC Impact Goals (the “Multiplier Effect”) and ultimate WFH creation via leveraging CWFHA’s WFH Investment pipeline, the CWFHA Coalition and CWFHA’s WFH investment expertise, and as such the Parties desire to enter into a long-term strategic joint venture (the “RCJV”) to:”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2026/02/exhibit-174-rwnyc-cirrus-mou_redacted.pdf
